expectation: Start with an empty song or a clear new-song choice
action: Inspect opening workspace; click Play then Stop; open File
observed: Opens a short named example with one audio waveform. Play changes to Pause, moving playhead and green track meters confirm transport activity. Audio not yet auditioned from recording.

expectation: New should provide a blank song and a way to choose drums
action: File > New; Choose instrument; select the default R1 Drums and Add instrument track
observed: Blank-project call to action clearly leads to built-in instrument cards. R1 Drums is selected by default. Browser says 0 plug-ins at top while collection says 3, mildly confusing but built-ins are visible.

expectation: A built-in drum instrument and a preset named Electro or GM Kit should supply drum sounds
action: Inspect new drum instrument; choose Kits > Electro; click pad 1; try GM Kit
observed: All 16 pads remain labeled Empty. Selected pad says No sample with Load sample prompts. Electro changes several parameter values but provides no visible drum sound. GM Kit also remains Empty. Cannot tell whether included kits are sounds or only settings.
confusion: Drum instrument appears to require files that a beginner may not have

expectation: Double-clicking the blank pattern should open a place to make beats
action: Close instrument; double-click blank pattern; rename Dance beat; double-click again; right-click and choose Edit notes
observed: Double-clicking the pattern name repeatedly opens rename. Right-click reveals Edit notes and looping actions, providing the eventual path to editing.

No chooser observed; error banner appeared behind modal. Coordinator separately reported missing GTK schemas and repaired environment, so this attempt is environment-confounded. Audio output stream failed banner instructs Play to reconnect.

expectation: Retry playback should reconnect sound; audio setup should show usable outputs
action: Retry playback; Details; Audio setup; choose alternate Rill lab paced output and Apply; Play
observed: Retry retained failure. Details names ALSA I/O error (5). Setup initially appeared near top then recentered, causing one click on stale location. Alternate output selection clears error banner at next observation; no verified sound yet.

expectation: Drum editing should show drum names or a beat grid
action: Inspect Clip Editor; inspect Notes and View menus; open Generate
observed: Editor has piano pitches C3/C4/C5 and no visible drum names. Notes menu offers technical transforms; View offers scale/chord options; Generate offers Chord, Arpeggio, Melody, no apparent drum option. Still unsure which line is kick or snare. Audio output failure returns after alternate output attempt.

expectation: Short notes evenly spaced should make a dance rhythm
action: Choose Length 1/16 and Pencil; draw four evenly spaced C4 notes, D4 notes on second and fourth beats, and four alternating F4 notes; return to Arranger; context menu > Loop playback over selection; Play
observed: Ten note marks and velocity bars appear. Arranger pattern preview contains notes. Naming and drawing are learnable after discovery. Drum mapping and audio remain unverified.

expectation: Loop playback should repeat my one-bar phrase
action: Inspect playback after waiting; Stop; Add track > Add instrument track; choose R1 Mini, Acid Line preset; open its new pattern with context menu
observed: Loop range correctly shrinks to one bar and Loop is enabled. Playback stops itself and failure banner returns. Adding a second instrument is straightforward after learning the browser; it creates its own blank pattern. Mini preset names suggest usable bass sounds.

expectation: A second instrument can add a bass phrase and Ctrl+S should preserve the project
action: Draw four 1/8 notes on Mini at varying heights; Ctrl+S; save as exports/neon-steps.rill
observed: Second pattern preview shows notes. Native save dialog accepts the full session path; project title changes to neon-steps. Coordinator supplied a 12-second audio capture around earlier drum playback and reported measured silence; not a heard audition and cause unproven.

expectation: Export WAV makes a playable version
action: File > Export WAV; keep Mix/WAV/32-bit float/follow audio setup/Arrangement defaults; Export; accept neon-steps.wav in exports folder
observed: Export options show Arrangement 0:02 + tails. Native chooser opens after a short delay. App then shows Exporting with elapsed time and Cancel export. Many technical settings are unfamiliar, but a default path exists.

expectation: Export should confirm completion; drum instrument should retain the selected kit name
action: Wait for export; inspect Track > Channel > Instrument on drums; retry Load sample after environment repair
observed: Exported neon-steps.wav confirmation appears with Copy path. Reopening R1 Drums shows preset Custom despite earlier GM Kit selection and no intentional drum parameter changes since. Pads remain Empty. Proceeding to retry file picker.

expectation: Sample loading might reveal included drums; duplication can make a longer dance phrase
action: Wait for Load sample chooser; cancel because only own export is shown; close instrument and underlying Channel dialog; box-select both patterns; choose Duplicate and click selected clip
observed: Repaired native chooser works and opens previous exports folder, not a bundled sound library. Export WAV file visibly exists. Closing Instrument returns to underlying Channel modal, briefly surprising. Duplicate toolbar activates a tool with helpful text; clicking one of the selected clips duplicates both tracks together.

expectation: Four repeated bars should make a complete short loop
action: Duplicate both tracks to four bars; box-select eight clips; Loop playback over selection; Ctrl+S; Play for about 20 seconds; Stop; File > Re-export last WAV (replace)
observed: Project duration 0:08; loop range 1.1-5.1. During final playback Mini meter turns green, drums meter does not in captured frame. Playback remains active at later screenshot, unlike earlier failure; still no personally heard audio. Re-export selected to update the final file.

Exported neon-steps.wav confirmation appears after four-bar re-export. Ending UI exploration at approximately 16 minutes. No source, project internals, logs beyond own input records, documentation beyond required AGENTS.md, other participant findings, or automated app state used to select actions.
